Legacy campaign

Beyond the Dynamo (1902–1921)

More people want electricity from the company you started in First Light. How many new customers can the old plants serve before you have to borrow for another one?

Open the Legacy campaign↗ Your decisions ↓

Play the chapters in order. You carry the same utility from one generation to the next.

Location
A fictional California utility
Starts in
1902
Generation
20 years

Your starting point

In 1902 you take over the same California utility you ran through the first generation. Its opening fleet and bank balance depend on what you did with those first twenty years.

Your goal is to grow the customer base by the end of 1921. Check how much extra demand the inherited fleet can meet before you order new capacity.

Learn how to play

Your decisions

  1. 01

    Make room for new customers

    Check when demand is closest to available supply. That's where new customers will first put pressure on the old plants.

  2. 02

    Finance the next plant

    Compare the extra revenue new customers could bring with the cost of borrowing to serve them. Any debt still outstanding in 1921 passes to your successor.

Which of your first investments still has room to grow?
